user.title: Connect to AquaIllumination Prime
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the lamp. Leave the password empty if the lamp is not password protected. Optionally give it a name; otherwise one is derived from its serial number.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The lamp rejected the stored password. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the lamp.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from the lamp. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This lamp is already configured. Its address has been updated.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Locations for weather, sun and moon, and how sun and moon times are mapped.

preset.title: Edit preset
preset.description: One time point per line: the time, then percent values for blue, green, deep red, warm white, cool white, for example: 07:10 37 37 37 37 37. Decimals are allowed, separators are spaces or commas, # starts a comment. Values from 0 to 100, times from 00:00 to 24:00, at least two points.

error.lightning_range: The minimum pause must not exceed the maximum.
error.invalid_line: Line {line}: expected a time and five percent values (blue, green, deep red, warm white, cool white).
error.invalid_time: Line {line}: invalid time, expected HH:MM between 00:00 and 24:00.
error.value_out_of_range: Line {line}: value must be between 0 and 100.
error.duplicate_time: Line {line}: this time appears more than once.
error.too_few_points: At least two time points are required.
error.lamp_rejected: Saved in Home Assistant, but the lamp rejected the schedule.
error.too_many_points: At most 32 time points are allowed.
